# MD Viewer

> A free, client-only Markdown (.md) file viewer. Drop or choose a file to read it fully formatted in the browser. Nothing is uploaded, saved, or cached — refreshing the page always returns to a blank slate.

MD Viewer is a single-page web tool at https://mlookd.com/. There is no sign-up, no backend, and no file storage: the Markdown file a visitor drops or selects is parsed and rendered entirely in their own browser using JavaScript, then discarded on refresh.

## Key facts

- What it does: renders GitHub-flavored Markdown (headings, tables, code blocks with copy buttons, links, images) as formatted HTML.
- Privacy: 100% client-side processing. No file is ever sent to a server, uploaded, logged, or stored in a database.
- Cost: free, no account required.
- Interface: drag-and-drop or a file picker, light/dark theme toggle, and a scroll-spy chapter sidebar (table of contents) generated from the document's headings.
- Platform: works in any modern desktop or mobile browser. Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite.
- Source code: https://github.com/filipeedr/md-viewer (open source).

## Common questions

- "Is my file uploaded anywhere?" — No. Processing happens only in the browser's memory; nothing leaves the visitor's machine.
- "Does it require an account or installation?" — No. It's a website, used directly in the browser.
- "What Markdown syntax is supported?" — GitHub-flavored Markdown: tables, fenced code blocks, task lists, links, images, and standard formatting.

## Pages

- [MD Viewer](https://mlookd.com/): the only page — drop a .md file to view it.
